reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows model TD3318B, which is on the recalled list, so the model is confirmed.
The duplicate check found another claim (d99b5c3c-6342-5210-8016-e531b84bb7e8) sharing the same label photo, so the claim must be sent to a person for review.

Retailer Designbydelta.com is on the sold-at list and the purchase date 2004-05-22 is inside the sale window; no receipt is required and no destruction photo is needed, so these checks do not block the claim.
